question_text: Republic Act No. 9512, also known as the National Environmental Awareness and Education Act of 2008, mandates the integration of environmental education into the school curriculum. Which of the following is a key requirement of this law?

options.text: All schools must offer a separate, stand-alone subject on environmental science from Grade 1 to college.
Environmental education shall be integrated into the curriculum at all levels, from elementary to tertiary, including values formation.
Only public schools are required to include environmental topics in their curriculum.
Environmental education is limited to topics on waste management and pollution control.
